title: Tooltips
description: Every hover tooltip added on this branch, one picture each, with the element being hovered in view.

shots.heading: Board tile hover
shots.caption: Hovering a hex lists its planets with resources and influence and who controls them, anomalies, wormholes, and the unit and command token counts.

shots.heading: Map zoom button
shots.caption: The zoom buttons name their action. (Zoom In sits at the left edge of the window and its tooltip is partly cut off there.)

shots.heading: Map overlay button
shots.caption: Each overlay button says what it shows: Ground Combat gives defenders, average hits and planetary shields. The tooltips now open below the toolbar; before, the map container clipped them.

shots.heading: Victory point breakdown
shots.caption: The victory point badge lists where the points come from: public and secret objectives, Mecatol Rex and Shards of the Throne.

shots.heading: Resources badge
shots.caption: Ready resources out of total resources.

shots.heading: Influence badge
shots.caption: Ready influence out of total influence.

shots.heading: Controlled systems
shots.caption: How many systems the player controls.

shots.heading: Controlled planets
shots.caption: How many planets the player controls.

shots.heading: Production capacity
shots.caption: Production capacity still available out of the total.

shots.heading: Strategy card
shots.caption: A strategy card chip shows the card's initiative and the primary and secondary abilities.

shots.heading: Action card in hand
shots.caption: A held action card shows its name, phase and full effect text.

shots.heading: Secret objective
shots.caption: A held secret objective shows its phase, victory points and requirement.

shots.heading: Turn sound
shots.caption: The sound button says what a click does (Mute turn sound or Turn sound on).

shots.heading: Event log: action card
shots.caption: An action card named in the log is underlined and shows its effect on hover.

shots.heading: Event log: actor
shots.caption: The coloured symbol in the log names the player and their position.

shots.heading: Combat: roll results
shots.caption: The hit count beside a ship type opens each die: the roll, the target number and whether it hit.

shots.heading: Invasion: default target
shots.caption: The star badge on the pre-selected planet says it is the default target.

shots.heading: Invasion: reset button
shots.caption: The reset button says it restores the default planet and all available troops.

shots.heading: Combat: destroyed this step
shots.caption: The red minus on a ship row counts ships destroyed in this step.

shots.heading: Combat: action card chip
shots.caption: Action cards a player holds are listed in the combat window and show their effect on hover.

shots.heading: Combat: fleet supply gauge
shots.caption: Explains the fleet supply gauge: non-fighter ships against the fleet supply pool.

shots.heading: Combat: capacity gauge
shots.caption: Explains the capacity gauge: capacity used by fighters and infantry against total transport capacity.

shots.heading: Reaction switch
shots.caption: The per-card switch says whether a click turns the card to Never or back to Always.

shots.heading: Combat odds: attacker win
shots.caption: Before the first roll the odds card shows a bar; hovering the attacker's part says "Attacker Win: 62%". The numbers come from a fixed simulated response.

shots.heading: Combat odds: mutual destruction
shots.caption: The thin middle part of the bar is the chance both fleets are destroyed: "Mutual Destruction: 10%".

shots.heading: Combat odds: defender win
shots.caption: The defender's part of the bar: "Defender Win: 28%".

shots.heading: Legendary planet
shots.caption: In the system inspector the star beside a legendary planet's name is labelled "Legendary Planet" (Primor here).

shots.heading: Lobby: remove player
shots.caption: In the lobby the host sees a cross on every other player's seat; its label names the seat: "Remove player at position 2".

notes.title: How they were captured
notes.text: Custom tooltips (the map, the victory point breakdown, the roll results) are real hover states. Browsers draw native title tooltips outside the page, so for those the capture draws the element's own title text where the browser would, and rings the element.

notes.title: Fixes made while capturing
notes.text: Map overlay and zoom tooltips opened upward and were clipped by the map container; they now open downward. Tooltips no longer wrap into a narrow column.

notes.title: Win-probability tooltips
notes.text: They need the odds service (POST /advisor/battle). The capture intercepts that request with Playwright route interception and answers a fixed simulation result (62% / 10% / 28%), so no advisor process is needed and the pixels are repeatable.
